entries.name: Cable Bay Walk

It describes the Cable Bay Vineyards winery, not a walk (tasting $10, updated Dec 2017).

entries.ticketUrl_note: No official walk page found; the walk is not described in any source read. Waiheke walks are in the Te Ara Hura network (Wikivoyage: about 100 km of tracks).

coordinates_check.note: Current point is the Cable Bay Vineyards winery at 12 Nick Johnstone Drive, not a trailhead. Start (Matiatia wharf) is -36.78049,174.99205; Cable Bay Beach end -36.80322,174.98869.
